fullPassage: An oilman, Calouste Gulbenkian, accumulated a fabulous art collection and called the works 'my children.' Mostly ignoring his flesh-and-blood son and daughter, he lived to serve his art. Claiming that 'my children must have privacy' and 'a home fit for Gulbenkians to live in,' he built a mansion in Paris with barricades, watchdogs and a private secret service. He routinely refused requests to loan his art to museums, and did not allow visitors, since 'my children mustn't be disturbed.' But even this extreme of a collector who prefers art to people shows the importance of the social role of collecting, since Gulbenkian simply treated artworks as if they were people. And, when Gulbenkian left his collection to found a museum in Lisbon upon his death in 1955, he showed that he cared about people after all—just not the ones he happened to know.

det.korean: accumulated: 주어(Calouste Gulbenkian) 뒤 과거시제 동사 자리. 뒤의 called(과거)와 and로 병렬되므로 과거시제가 필요. accumulate → accumulated(과거형). 1단어.
det.analysis: An oilman, Calouste Gulbenkian, [빈칸] a fabulous art collection and called the works \u2018my children.\u2019 → 주어 + 동사 자리. and called(과거)와 시제 병렬 → 과거형 accumulated. 조건 (1) accumulate 변형 충족, (2) 1단어 충족.
det.tip: accumulate = 축적하다, 모으다. and called와 병렬된 과거시제 동사 → accumulated. 시제 일치가 판단 근거.

questions.passage: An oilman, Calouste Gulbenkian, accumulated a fabulous art collection and called the works 'my children.' Mostly ignoring his flesh-and-blood son and daughter, he lived to serve his art. Claiming that 'my children must have privacy' and 'a home fit for Gulbenkians to live in,' he built a mansion in Paris with barricades, watchdogs and a private secret service. He routinely refused requests to loan his art to museums, and did not allow visitors, since 'my children mustn't be disturbed.' But even this extreme of a collector who __________ shows the importance of the social role of collecting, since Gulbenkian simply treated artworks as if they were people. And, when Gulbenkian left his collection to found a museum in Lisbon upon his death in 1955, he showed that he cared about people after all—just not the ones he happened to know.

다음 글의 빈칸에 알맞은 표현을 [조건]에 따라 영어로 쓰시오.

빈칸: But even this extreme of a collector who ______ shows the importance of the social role of collecting.

[조건] (1) prefers, art, to, people을 모두 사용할 것
       (2) 정확히 4단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: prefers art to people: 관계대명사 who 뒤 동사 자리. prefer A to B = B보다 A를 더 좋아하다. 주인공이 사람보다 예술을 더 좋아한 수집가임을 강조. 4단어: prefers(1) art(2) to(3) people(4).
det.analysis: a collector who [빈칸] shows ... → who 뒤 동사 자리. prefer A to B 구문 적용. prefers(3인칭 단수 현재) art to people. 조건 (1) 네 단어 모두 사용 충족, (2) 4단어 충족.
det.tip: prefer A to B = B보다 A를 더 좋아함. 주어가 3인칭 단수(a collector)이므로 prefers. 'art to people' 순서 중요(A to B).
